rules.title: How to play
rules.who: This is Findo. She is hiding on every map.
rules.find.body: She is drawn like everyone else around her. Look for the brown braids, the yellow top and the violet skirt.
rules.move: Drag to move, pinch to zoom
rules.move.body: The maps are far bigger than the screen. On the later levels you will not find her without zooming in.
rules.wrong.body: Tapping the wrong person takes 15 points and 3 seconds off the clock.
rules.fast: The faster you find her, the better
rules.fast.body: Every second left on the clock is worth 10 points, and your total decides one to three stars.
rules.hint.body: A hint moves the map towards Findo and makes her glow. You start with three.
